title: TEAMMATE PAD LOST GLYPH
why: The linked-window critic still found the controller glyph tiny because the path used only 18 pixels of its nominal 24px box.
now: The teammate warning controller drawing is 24px wide with the same 2px stroke.

edits.anchor: if(icon){ ctx.save(); ctx.translate(24,20); ctx.strokeStyle=UIC.warn; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.stroke(icon); ctx.restore(); }
edits.replacement:
// v28.xx (cw-cx-padlostglyph): the controller path is 18 units wide in a 24-unit box; show a full 24px glyph, with the same 2px stroke.
      if(icon){ ctx.save(); ctx.translate(20,16); ctx.scale(4/3,4/3); ctx.strokeStyle=UIC.warn; ctx.lineWidth=1.5; ctx.stroke(icon); ctx.restore(); }
